title: Gold & Silver
intro: Ways to own gold and silver without lockers: exchange-traded funds, fund-of-funds, Sovereign Gold Bonds and digital gold. Cost, tracking accuracy, tax and how safely the metal is held matter most.
newsQuery: gold ETF silver ETF sovereign gold bond India
sources: sharpely.in ETF and mutual fund pages (data as of 5 Oct 2026)
AMC scheme pages (Nippon India, HDFC, SBI, ICICI Prudential MF)
SEBI public advisory on digital gold / e-gold (8 Nov 2025)
Union Budget 2026 SGB capital-gains amendment (effective 1 Apr 2026)
Income-tax capital gains rules effective 23 Jul 2024 (Finance Act 2024)

params.label: Expense ratio
params.tip: Annual scheme cost as of 5 Oct 2026 (sharpely). FoF figures are direct-plan TER; the underlying ETF's costs are also borne. SGBs have no expense ratio. Digital gold has no TER but a ~3% GST plus buy-sell spread.

params.label: Tracking error
params.tip: How closely the ETF follows domestic gold/silver prices, as of 5 Oct 2026 (sharpely). Lower is better.

params.label: 1-year return
params.tip: Trailing 1-year return to 5 Oct 2026 (sharpely). Mostly reflects the metal price, not fund skill.

params.label: 3-year return (CAGR)
params.tip: Annualised 3-year return to 5 Oct 2026 (sharpely). Past returns do not predict future ones.

params.label: Minimum investment
params.tip: ETFs: price of one unit (NAV, 5 Oct 2026). FoFs: minimum lump sum. Digital gold: provider's stated minimum.

params.label: Tax treatment
params.tip: Rules for purchases after 23 Jul 2024. Short-term gains are taxed at your slab rate.

params.label: Storage & purity
params.tip: How and where the metal is held, and its purity.

items.name: Nippon India ETF Gold BeES

v.tax: Held >12 months: LTCG 12.5% without indexation; otherwise slab rate
v.storage: Physical gold (0.995 fineness) held by custodian; no storage cost to you

pros: Very liquid on NSE/BSE with tight spreads
Buy as little as one unit
cons: Highest expense ratio among the big gold ETFs (0.81%)
Needs a demat and trading account
Brokerage and DP charges apply
items.best: Traders and investors who want the most liquid gold ETF

v.storage: Physical gold (0.995 fineness) held by custodian; no storage cost to you

Cheaper than Gold BeES and SBI Gold ETF

items.name: SBI Gold ETF

v.storage: Physical gold (0.995 fineness) held by custodian; no storage cost to you

items.name: ICICI Prudential Gold ETF

v.storage: Physical gold (0.995 fineness) held by custodian; no storage cost to you

v.storage: Invests in Nippon India ETF Gold BeES; units held in your MF folio

items.name: Sovereign Gold Bonds (secondary market)

v.tax: Interest (2.5% a year) taxed at slab. Since 1 Apr 2026 the tax-free maturity redemption applies only to original subscribers who hold to maturity; secondary-market buyers pay capital-gains tax (LTCG 12.5% if held >12 months)
v.storage: Paper gold backed by Government of India; no storage, redeemed at 999-purity gold price

pros: Extra 2.5% a year interest on issue price
Older series sometimes trade below the gold price
cons: No new issues since Feb 2024; buy only on NSE/BSE
Thin, uneven liquidity across series
Secondary buyers lost the tax-free maturity benefit from 1 Apr 2026
Minimum is 1 gram at market price
items.best: Patient demat investors who can buy a series at a discount and hold

items.name: MMTC-PAMP Digital Gold

v.tax: Held >24 months: LTCG 12.5% without indexation; otherwise slab rate. 3% GST on purchase
v.storage: 24K 999.9 gold in insured vaults; free storage for 5 years, fee after

pros: Buy from ₹1 via many payment apps
LBMA-accredited refiner JV with a government company
cons: Not regulated by SEBI or RBI (SEBI caution, Nov 2025)
3% GST plus buy-sell spread (~3% or more) on each round trip
Storage fees after 5 years
items.best: Very small, occasional buys or saving towards a coin

items.name: SafeGold Digital Gold

v.tax: Held >24 months: LTCG 12.5% without indexation; otherwise slab rate. 3% GST on purchase
v.storage: 24K 99.5% gold in insured Brink's vaults with an independent trustee; free storage period then fee

pros: Start from ₹10 on its app (lower on some partner apps)
Independent trustee and Brink's vault custody
cons: Not regulated by SEBI or RBI (SEBI caution, Nov 2025)
3% GST plus buy-sell spread on each round trip
Purity 99.5%, below MMTC-PAMP's 999.9
items.best: Micro-savers who may later want physical coins
